lead: A defaulted type parameter on a shared type breaks every unqualified associated path on it, three files away.
body: `StatementCache<H = String>` compiles, then `StatementCache::capacity_for(block)` fails with `E0283: cannot infer type of the type parameter H`, because a default is not inference fallback and rustc unifies `H` only from a concrete inherent impl. Move the items that never mention `H` out of the impl into free functions rather than reaching for a turbofish; a 20-line `rustc --crate-type lib` probe under `.agent-tmp/` answers this in one call.
